```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  fig.align = "center"
)
library(tidyverse)
theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
)
qc <- read_tsv(
  "../output/qc/sample_qc_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    rrna_mean_pct =
      (rrna_r1_pct + rrna_r2_pct) / 2,

    hbrna_mean_pct =
      (hbrna_r1_pct + hbrna_r2_pct) / 2
  )
```

# Data Summary
```{r data-summary}
tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Samples",
    "Individuals",
    "Baseline samples",
    "Follow-up samples"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(qc),
    n_distinct(qc$individual),
    sum(qc$timepoint == "baseline"),
    sum(qc$timepoint == "follow-up")
  )
)
```

```{r group-summary}
qc |>

    name = "samples"
  )
```

# Salmon QC {.tabset}
## Mapping Rate
```{r mapping-rate}
qc |>
  arrange(mapping_rate) |>
  mutate(
    sample_order = row_number()
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      sample_order,
      mapping_rate
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Samples ordered by mapping rate",
    y = "Salmon mapping rate (%)"
  )
```

# QC Summary
```{r qc-summary}
qc |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        mapping_rate,
        library_compatible_pct,
        decoy_pct,
        fragment_length_mean,
        fragment_length_sd,
        rrna_mean_pct,
        hbrna_mean_pct
      ),
      list(
        min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("metric", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(min|median|max)$"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(min, median, max),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    ),
    metric = metric |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_sentence()
  )
```

# Sample QC Summary
```{r sample-qc-summary}
sample_qc <- qc |>
  transmute(
    run,
    sample,
    individual,
    disease_state,
    timepoint,
    mapping_rate =
      round(mapping_rate, 2),
    library_type,
    library_compatible_pct =
      round(library_compatible_pct, 2),
    decoy_pct =
      round(decoy_pct, 2),
    fragment_length_mean =
      round(fragment_length_mean, 2),
    fragment_length_sd =
      round(fragment_length_sd, 2),
    rrna_mean_pct =
      round(rrna_mean_pct, 2),
    hbrna_mean_pct =
      round(hbrna_mean_pct, 2)
  )
sample_qc
```

# Lowest Mapping Samples
```{r lowest-mapping}
sample_qc |>
  arrange(mapping_rate) |>
  slice_head(
    n = 15
  )
```

# Highest rRNA Samples
```{r highest-rrna}
sample_qc |>
  arrange(
    desc(rrna_mean_pct)
  ) |>
  slice_head(
    n = 15
  )
```
